subject: Zoning Ordinance Modernization Framework
overview: The committee met with consultants from Innes Associates to review and refine proposed updates to the zoning ordinance's definitions and table of uses. The body worked to categorize zoning changes into priority 'buckets' for reporting out to the full City Council by the end of the fiscal year.

items.title: Zoning Memo and Table of Uses Updates
items.summary: The committee reviewed formatting changes to the table of uses, including the consolidation of parking and loading codes into a single readable reference.

items.title: Definitions - Dwelling Multifamily
items.summary: Members discussed replacing specific residential classes with a neutral 'multi-unit' definition but requested the consultant return with options that align with current dimensional story-height requirements to avoid unintended zoning conflicts.

items.title: Definition - Doggie Daycare
items.summary: The committee refined a new definition for doggie daycare facilities to distinguish them from overnight animal boarding and kennels.

items.title: Definitions - Household and Multi-Tenant Living
items.summary: The body debated how to define 'household' to address modern living arrangements and multi-tenant structures without infringing on tenant rights or illegal consanguinity rules.

items.title: Definitions - Industrial and Commercial Uses
items.summary: Members clarified definitions for institutional uses, mixed-use development, class three motor vehicle sales, and junkyards to close regulatory gaps identified by city staff.

items.title: Definitions - Manufactured and Tiny Homes
items.summary: The committee reviewed definitions for manufactured homes and tiny houses, both stationary and movable, to prepare for future accessory dwelling unit (ADU) and infill housing policies.

items.title: Definitions - Accessory Structures and Uses
items.summary: The committee updated the definitions for accessory uses and structures to remove vague language regarding the 'character' of the neighborhood.

items.title: Lot Coverage and Dimensional Requirements
items.summary: The committee postponed updating the lot coverage definition until broader dimensional reforms are addressed to ensure new definitions do not accidentally reduce buildability on non-conforming lots.

items.title: Future Work Plan and Phase 1 Package
items.summary: The body agreed to bundle a package of non-substantive definitions, the updated table of uses, and the digitized zoning map for a formal vote on May 22.

items.title: Climate Action and Adaptation Plan Review
items.summary: Staff and consultants provided a cross-reference of climate action strategies to be integrated into future zoning buckets, including transportation and green space requirements.
